name: transliterate
description: Transliterate Cyrillic, Greek and Arabic text into Latin letters from tables in the program: Cyrillic by ISO 9:1995 (Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian, Serbian, Macedonian, Bulgarian), scholarly transliteration or BGN/PCGN 1947 for Russian (ye after vowels, kh, shch); Greek by ELOT 743 / ISO 843 transcription with its position rules (av/af, mp/b, ng, nch); Arabic by a simplified ALA-LC (consonants, long vowels, vowel marks when written). Case is kept (Щ Shch, ЩИ SHCHI).

text.description: Text in any mix of Cyrillic, Greek and Arabic; other characters are copied

cyrillic_system.description: iso9: all Slavic Cyrillic letters; scholarly and bgn_pcgn: Russian alphabet

cyrillic_signs.description: Soft and hard signs: the system's marks, ASCII ' and ", or dropped

greek_diaeresis.description: Greek ϊ ϋ as ï ÿ (keep) or i y (drop)

catalog.source: ISO 9:1995 table; BGN/PCGN 1947 romanization of Russian (US Board on Geographic Names / Permanent Committee on Geographical Names); scientific transliteration of Cyrillic; ELOT 743:2001 = ISO 843:1997 transcription (UN-approved for Greek); ALA-LC Arabic romanization table (Library of Congress)
